output_text: A single blood pressure reading of 128/82 mmHg is mildly above the ideal range, but one reading alone does not diagnose high blood pressure. It is reasonable to recheck it when you are rested, track readings over time, and discuss the pattern with your clinician, especially if readings are often elevated or you have symptoms such as chest pain, shortness of breath, severe headache, or weakness.
